purpose: Teach: 下方/私鉄/郵貯/竣工/インサイド/四方/ロイター/パーフェクト

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 業績の下方修正を避けるよう頑張りましょう
lines.en: Let's focus on avoiding a downward revision in our performance targets.
lines.style: Measured, professional. Clear enunciation on key points. Moderate pace, businesslike. Slight pause before the core instruction to signal importance.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。私鉄駅前の物件を調査します
lines.en: Understood. I'll conduct a survey of the properties near the private railway stations.
lines.style: Attentive, ready-to-move. Clipped affirmation. Rapid transition into task confirmation. Competent, no-nonsense tone.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 郵貯振込のお客様にも対応しましょう
lines.en: And let's make sure we're accommodating customers using postal transfer services as well.
lines.style: Steady, inclusive. Soft emphasis on 'as well' to signal thoroughness. Measured pace, delegating without pressure.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。竣工後の内覧会を企画します
lines.en: Got it. I'll plan an open-house viewing event for after the completion ceremony.
lines.style: Responsive, efficient. Affirmative with quiet confidence. Task stated factually, no embellishment. Steady, professional cadence.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 業界インサイドの専門家を招きましょう
lines.en: We should also bring in an industry expert who can speak to market insights.
lines.style: Purposeful, strategic. Slight lift on 'also' to show this builds on prior points. Clear articulation. Measured tempo, thinking-ahead tone.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。四方の競合動向を整理します
lines.en: Absolutely. I'll compile a competitive landscape analysis covering all four market segments.
lines.style: Assured, competent. Direct affirmation. Rapid, organized delivery on the task itself. Professional steadiness throughout.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: ロイター記事を経営会議で共有しましょう
lines.en: Let's also share the Reuters article at the next management meeting.
lines.style: Clear, purposeful directive. Even pacing. Decisive without being commanding. Slight vocal weight on 'management meeting' to emphasize venue.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。プロジェクトをパーフェクトに完遂します
lines.en: Yes. I'll ensure this project is executed flawlessly from start to finish.
lines.style: Final commitment, resolute. Affirmation lands with quiet strength. Steady pace throughout. Each phrase carries equal weight. Closes the conversation.
